column1: # Original DICE Quadrapong, DIP 0 (1 coin / 1 credit; a credit is one two-player
# game, two credits one four-player game). Start without a credit (200 ms), one coin
# without Start (500 ms), a second coin (800 ms), then Start begins a four-player game.
# Each paddle sweeps its full range alone (2050-2710 ms: left, right, top, bottom); a
# recorded closed-loop rally (2750-15999 ms) gives contacts by all four paddles; then
# every paddle parks at its low end until three players are out and the game ends
# (50.9 s); one coin and Start restart a cleared two-player game, recorded closed-loop
# for the left and right paddles (53500-61999 ms). Original SDL int16 axes.
